_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Statistically a coil until ETF flows rebound with upside momentum or a positioning unwind drives fear/greed below 40; crowded longs are a latent risk not yet a breaker.
next_move.brains_agree: partial split — analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative flags long crowding risk without endorsing upside
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound, fear/greed 45-55, spot ETF flows remain flat
next_move.invalidated_if: sustained ETF-flow rebound plus 30d momentum break up, or positioning unwind driving fear/greed below 40
